title: EMIR Counterparty Pairing Reconciler
description: Pair two counterparties' EMIR Refit reports by UTI and reconcile the caller-supplied matching-field set (up to 148 fields per the 2026 escalation) within a configurable per-field numeric tolerance. Identifies reconciliation breaks — value mismatches beyond tolerance — so a firm catches the pairing failure before the Trade Repository rejects it. Returns paired status, matched fields, and break list. Zero network, zero PII.

report_a.description: Counterparty A's trade report fields (must include uti)

report_b.description: Counterparty B's trade report fields (must include uti)

matching_fields.description: List of field names to reconcile (max 148)

numeric_tolerance_pct.description: Percentage tolerance for numeric field comparison (e.g. 1 = 1%)
